title: Ok Wangeyo Saa Ma Nobie
stanzas: Ok wangeyo saa ma nobie, kat` okinyi, kat` odhiambo,Di po kobiro ka piny chido, kata saa ma piny dwaro ru.Ochikowa mondo warite, kik wawe techewa otho,Mondo ka obiro oyudwa wan duto kwarito Ruodhwa.

Aparo ng`wonone maduong` ngang`, ma nomiye thonwa e yath,Koweyo duong`ne polo malo, mond` otho ni jo maricho.Ang`eyo ka Ruodhwa dimor ngang` ka jogo ma notho nigi mor,Ka gikiyo duok Ruodhwa, ka giduto rite pile.
Ruoth Yesu, jawarna mohera, Ing`eyo kaheri adier;Ageno naneni gi wang`a ka iniruaka e polo.Kibiro kaka jang`ad bura ni jogo maringo wang`i,An to anamosi, Osiepna; An to arito bironi.
chorus: Wa rito Ruodhwa; ( warito kendo wakiyo Ruodhwa;) Warito Ruodhwa; ( warito kendo wakiyo Ruodhwa;) Warito Ruodhwa; Warito kendo wakiyo Ruoth.
